{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "hydrophobic_surface_partitioning",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "halogenated_aromatic_core",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid", "aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Halogenated aromatics are the classic high-logD motif: polarizable nonpolar surface on a rigid pi scaffold."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Extended aromatic systems add nonpolar surface area that partitions preferentially into octanol; 1982 candidates give firm support."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_hydration_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.55,
          "rationale": "Dense heteroatoms increase hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, suppressing measured logD across 2661 candidates."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "low_heteroatom_nonpolar",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Few polar atoms means weak hydration; mirrors the source H-bond-donor role mapped onto heteroatom count."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.9,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.45,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.15,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Domain prior: lipophilicity equals nonpolar surface (halogen, aromatic) minus polar hydration burden (heteroatoms). Fails if logD variance here is dominated by ionization state or scaffold size rather than atomic composition."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "ring_anchored_length_skeptic",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "fused_ring_scaffold",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried the strongest transfer weight (0.758); rigid fused hydrophobic rings favor octanol partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "damped_length_transfer",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.15,
          "rationale": "Source length effect had lowest role confidence (0.224), so its sign-reversed bulk bonus is kept deliberately weak."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "very_long_saturation_reversal",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_very_long"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: size benefit saturates; very long molecules typically carry solubilizing chains that lower logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branch_transfer_reversal",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.3,
          "rationale": "Reverses the uncertain rotatable-bond role: heavy branching often marks polar substituents, not added hydrophobic bulk."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.3,
      "prior_scale": 0.28,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "hypothesis": "Keeps only the high-weight ring transfer, damps the low-confidence length transfer, and reverses the branch role. Fails if ESOL size and flexibility effects do transfer cleanly with inverted sign to logD."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "hydrophobic_surface_partitioning",
  "lesson": "With no target feedback, cross-endpoint transfer stays hypothetical: low-confidence roles deserve damping, while mechanistic composition descriptors with large bin support are the safer deployment prior.",
  "revision_summary": "Reformatted conditions as field:value objects per schema. In the domain skill, promoted the halogen-plus-aromatic interaction to an explicit two-condition rule (a mechanistically justified halogenated-aromatic motif) and dropped the standalone halogen rule, keeping the symmetric heteroatom pair. Rebuilt the second skill as a cleaner counter-hypothesis: retain only the highest-weight ring transfer, sharply damp the low-confidence length transfer, and reverse the uncertain rotatable-bond-to-branch relation. Lowered its semantic mass and confidence accordingly, and deployed the composition-driven prior."
}
